clauses.title: Purpose
clauses.text: Each party wishes to disclose Confidential Information to the other for the purpose of evaluating and discussing a potential business relationship between them (the "Purpose").

clauses.title: Definition of Confidential Information
clauses.text: "Confidential Information" means all information of a confidential nature disclosed by or on behalf of one party (the "Discloser") to the other party (the "Recipient"), whether before or after the date of this Agreement, in any form, including business, technical, financial and product information, and any information that is marked as confidential or would reasonably be regarded as confidential.

clauses.title: Exclusions from Confidential Information
clauses.text: Confidential Information does not include information that: (a) is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully in the Recipient's possession before disclosure; (c) is lawfully received from a third party without restriction; or (d) is independently developed by the Recipient without use of the Discloser's Confidential Information.

clauses.title: Confidentiality obligations
clauses.text: The Recipient shall: (a) keep the Discloser's Confidential Information confidential; (b) use it only for the Purpose; and (c) not disclose it to any person except its employees, officers, professional advisers and subcontractors who need to know it for the Purpose and who are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than those in this Agreement.

clauses.title: Standard of care
clauses.text: The Recipient shall protect the Discloser's Confidential Information using at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own confidential information, and in any event no less than reasonable care.

clauses.title: Compelled disclosure
clauses.text: The Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to the extent required by law, regulation or a court of competent jurisdiction, provided that, where legally permitted, it gives the Discloser prompt written notice and reasonable assistance to seek a protective order.

clauses.title: Return or destruction
clauses.text: On the Discloser's written request, the Recipient shall promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information of the Discloser in its possession, save that the Recipient may retain copies held in routine backups or as required by law, which shall remain subject to this Agreement.

clauses.title: Ownership and no licence
clauses.text: All Confidential Information remains the property of the Discloser. Nothing in this Agreement grants the Recipient any licence or right in respect of the Discloser's Confidential Information or intellectual property, other than to use it for the Purpose.

clauses.title: No warranty
clauses.text: Confidential Information is provided "as is". The Discloser gives no warranty as to its accuracy or completeness.

clauses.title: Term and survival
clauses.text: This Agreement starts on the date of last signature and continues for two (2) years. The obligations in this Agreement shall continue for three (3) years from the date of termination or expiry, except in relation to trade secrets, which shall be protected for as long as they remain trade secrets.

clauses.title: Equitable remedies
clauses.text: Each party acknowledges that damages alone may not be an adequate remedy for breach of this Agreement and that the Discloser shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief or specific performance.

clauses.title: No obligation to transact
clauses.text: Nothing in this Agreement obliges either party to enter into any further agreement or transaction.

clauses.title: Entire agreement
clauses.text: This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties relating to its subject matter and supersedes all prior agreements, arrangements and understandings between them relating to that subject matter.

clauses.title: Assignment
clauses.text: Neither party may assign or transfer this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, except that either party may assign this Agreement to a member of its group or to a successor to all or substantially all of its business.

clauses.title: Notices
clauses.text: Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by hand, by pre-paid recorded post or by email to the address set out at the top of this Agreement, or such other address as a party notifies to the other.

clauses.title: Third party rights
clauses.text: A person who is not a party to this Agreement has no right under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 to enforce any of its terms.

clauses.title: Variation
clauses.text: No variation of this Agreement shall be effective unless it is in writing and signed by authorised representatives of both parties.

clauses.title: Counterparts and e-signature
clauses.text: This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which is an original and all of which together constitute one agreement. Electronic signatures are valid and binding.

clauses.title: Severance
clauses.text: If any provision of this Agreement is found to be invalid or unenforceable, that provision shall be deemed modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it valid, and the remaining provisions shall not be affected.

clauses.title: Waiver
clauses.text: No failure or delay by a party in exercising any right or remedy shall operate as a waiver of that right or remedy.

clauses.title: Governing law
clauses.text: This Agreement and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by the law of England and Wales.

clauses.title: Jurisdiction
clauses.text: The courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.

clauses.title: Incorporation and precedence
clauses.text: This Order Form is governed by and incorporates the Example Licence Terms (the "Terms"). In the event of conflict between this Order Form and the Terms, the Terms shall prevail unless this Order Form expressly states that a specific provision of the Terms is varied.

clauses.title: Licence grant
clauses.text: Subject to payment of the Fees, Example grants the Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable licence during the Subscription Term to use the Software for the number of users or agents set out in this Order Form, solely for the Customer's internal business purposes.

clauses.title: Licence restrictions
clauses.text: The Customer shall not: (a) copy, modify or create derivative works of the Software; (b) reverse engineer, decompile or disassemble the Software except as permitted by law; (c) sublicense, rent, lease or resell the Software; or (d) use the Software to test any system without the authorisation of its owner.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: Example and its licensors own all intellectual property rights in the Software and documentation. Except for the licence expressly granted in this Order Form, no rights are granted to the Customer.

clauses.title: Subscription term and renewal
clauses.text: The Subscription Term is twelve (12) months from the Start Date. The subscription shall renew for successive twelve (12) month periods unless either party gives at least thirty (30) days' written notice before the end of the then-current term.

clauses.title: Fees and payment terms
clauses.text: The Customer shall pay the Fees within thirty (30) days of the date of invoice. Fees are exclusive of VAT and other applicable taxes. Example may change the Fees for any renewal term by giving at least sixty (60) days' written notice before the renewal date.

clauses.title: Late payment
clauses.text: If the Customer fails to pay any undisputed amount by the due date, Example may charge interest at 4% per annum above the Bank of England base rate and, after giving fourteen (14) days' written notice, suspend access to the Software until payment is made.

clauses.title: Performance warranty
clauses.text: Example warrants that the Software will perform materially in accordance with its documentation. The Customer's sole remedy for breach of this warranty is for Example to use reasonable efforts to correct the non-conformity or, failing that, to refund the Fees paid for the remainder of the Subscription Term.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.text: Each party shall comply with applicable data protection law. To the extent Example processes personal data on the Customer's behalf, the parties shall comply with Example's Data Processing Addendum, which is incorporated by reference.

clauses.title: Liability cap
clauses.text: Except for liability that cannot be limited by law, each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, whether in contract, tort (including negligence) or otherwise, shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

clauses.title: Exclusion of indirect loss
clauses.text: Neither party shall be liable for any loss of profits, loss of revenue, loss of business, loss of goodwill or any indirect or consequential loss.

clauses.title: Liability that cannot be limited
clauses.text: Nothing in this Agreement limits or excludes either party's liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation, or any other liability that cannot be limited or excluded by law.

clauses.title: IP indemnity
clauses.text: Example shall defend the Customer against any third-party claim that the Customer's use of the Software in accordance with this Agreement infringes that third party's UK intellectual property rights, and shall pay any damages finally awarded, provided the Customer promptly notifies Example, allows Example sole control of the defence and gives reasonable assistance.

clauses.title: Termination for breach
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice if the other party commits a material breach which is not remedied within thirty (30) days of notice, or becomes insolvent.

clauses.title: Publicity
clauses.text: Neither party shall use the other party's name or logo in any publicity without the other party's prior written consent.

clauses.title: Licence verification
clauses.text: On no more than one occasion in any twelve (12) month period and on at least thirty (30) days' written notice, Example may verify the Customer's compliance with the licence limits in this Order Form. The Customer shall provide reasonable information to enable this.
